risk_description: Insider leaks confidential financial data including employee salaries to a competitor; consequences span loss of competitive advantage; legal exposure; reputational damage
vulnerability: Broad access to confidential financial data with no egress control or monitoring; no detection of bulk access or exfiltration
existing_controls: None effective — the event was not prevented or detected before disclosure
proposed_treatment: Least privilege review of access to HR and finance data; data classification and labelling; DLP on egress channels; monitoring and alerting on bulk access and download; joiner-mover-leaver process; access recertification; awareness training
notes: Impact rated on financial loss only, per the supplied criteria. Legal and reputational consequences named in the scenario are not represented in that scale and are recorded here as an understatement of true impact. Salary data is employee personal information — privacy obligations and any notification duty are a separate track from this risk. Likelihood of 3 reflects a realised event; after treatment the rating expresses likelihood of recurrence, not of the original incident.
